text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Look, Mr. C.B. and Maruzensky are talking together!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I bet they're discussing incredibly high-level race techniques!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On my way to lunch, I spot two students at the center of a crowd. I'm looking on absentmindedly when suddenly…

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hey, you there! Would you mind coming over here for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Are you free to talk? I've got a question for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. has a stern look on her face. I can tell she's about to ask a complex question about racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hope I can provide a response sophisticated enough to show that I'm a reputable trainer…

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: How can I get better at cooking?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: C.B. came to ask me for advice on living alone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm a little worried about her. And I'd like her to take good care of herself.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You live alone, right, Trainer? Don't you have any sweet tips to offer?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I'm a bit of a scatterbrain, you know! Some of the stuff I do would probably give you a good laugh!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: But cooking's such a hassle, right? I always end up making simple dishes like fried rice.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You can't live like that! A racer's body is her greatest asset.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I learn that there's more to Mr. C.B. than I thought. Although I do find myself wanting to give her heaps of advice…
choice_data_list: I'm probably not the right person to ask about that.
I'm probably not the right person to ask about that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm? Really?
choice_data_list: I always let my laundry pile up…

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ugh, tell me about it!
choice_data_list: And I always put off cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I hear that!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'm too lazy to cook every night, so I just make a massive portion of curry in advance!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That great big washing machine in the dorm really comes in handy if you've got a heap of laundry to do. You can wash it all at once.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And never store curry at room temperature. It spoils really fast, so make sure you put it in the fridge, or freeze it right after cooking.
choice_data_list: You really know all about this stuff!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heh, I guess a little. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Boy, living on your own makes you appreciate what your parents did for you, huh!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Having someone cook three meals a day for you is pretty incredible when you think about it.
choice_data_list: Actually, you asked about cooking in the first place, right?
Actually, you asked about cooking in the first place, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes, I'd almost forgotten what this was all about.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ooh, did you get a flash of inspiration?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My conversation with Mr. C.B. painted a clear picture of a laid-back, orderless lifestyle. The best advice for someone like her would be…
choice_data_list: I think rough-and-ready cooking suits you perfectly.
I think rough-and-ready cooking suits you perfectly.
Challenge yourself to whip up some creative cuisine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My conversation with Mr. C.B. painted a clear picture of a laid-back, orderless lifestyle. The best advice for someone like her would be…
choice_data_list: I think rough-and-ready cooking suits you perfectly.
I think rough-and-ready cooking suits you perfectly.
Challenge yourself to whip up some creative cuisine!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha! You sure know how to give a compliment.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: That's right. I am Mr. C.B., after all. If worrying about the details keeps me from having any fun, then there's no point!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, true. Fun is definitely the best ingredient.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Thanks, you two! I'd like to invite you both to dinner to show my appreciation. How about it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Mr. C.B.'s approach to cooking is undoubtedly crude, the results are delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Something creative! I like the sound of that!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm… I've cooked Italian food before, for example, but it's totes difficult. Are you really up for this?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, I have no idea how this is going to turn out, but I'm always up for a challenge!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Time to enjoy some creative freedom. This is getting exciting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Mr. C.B. gets to work on some original dishes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes super sweet mapo tofu, ramen-flavored pizza, and deep-fried fruit…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: None of the dishes end up tasting very good, but after seeing how much fun she had cooking everything, I can't help but feel happy myself, too.
